formulas.boards: Boards = (ceiling area × layers + trough board + partition faces × layers) ÷ board area × (1 + waste), rounded up
formulas.cRuns: C runs = (W ÷ C spacing) + 1 per room, each L long; cut onto bars with least waste
formulas.omegaRuns: Omega runs = (L ÷ omega spacing) + 1 per room, each W long + extra omega for troughs; cut onto bars
formulas.rods: Rods = hangers × (hanging height + cutting allowance), cut onto rods
formulas.vhangers: Vertical hangers = hangers × (hanging height + cutting allowance), cut onto C bars
formulas.clips: One clip at each C × omega crossing
formulas.edgeEst: Estimated perimeter = area × 0.7, cut onto bars
formulas.edgeRooms: Room sides cut onto angle bars
formulas.troughAngle: Trough m × protection angle per m
formulas.shadow: Shadow length cut onto profile bars
formulas.screws: Board m² × layers × screws per m² × (1 + waste)
formulas.tape: Finished m² × tape per m² × (1 + waste) ÷ roll length
formulas.compound: Finished m² × compound per m² × (1 + waste) ÷ bag weight
formulas.paint: Quantity = area × coats ÷ (coverage per litre × surface factor) × (1 + waste), then the cheapest pack mix
formulas.team: Days = area ÷ team productivity per day, × crew daily cost
formulas.extLump: Contractor lump sum split by area
formulas.missing: No complete product for this line (needs pack size, coverage and price)

contract.waMessage: Hello {name}, here is the quote and contract from {org}. You can review and accept it here: {url}
contract.intro: On {date}, this agreement is made between:
contract.preamble: Whereas the second party wishes to carry out {work} works at the location above, and whereas the first party is an establishment specialised in finishing works with the experience and means to carry them out, the parties, being of full legal capacity, have agreed as follows:
contract.s_annexBody: The preamble is an integral part of this contract, and quotation no. {quote} is an annex to it. In case of conflict, this contract prevails.
contract.s_scope_full: The first party shall supply and install the following works:
contract.s_scope_labour: The first party shall carry out the following works; the second party supplies the materials:
contract.s_scope_supply: The first party shall supply the materials for the following works, without installation:
contract.s_specsBody: Works are carried out to the following specifications, good trade practice and the manufacturers' instructions:
contract.s_valueNoVat: Total contract value {total}, not subject to VAT.
contract.s_valueUnit: Final settlement is on the actual executed and approved quantities after measurement, at the unit prices in the scope of works.
contract.s_valueLump: The value is a lump sum for the scope defined in this contract.
contract.s_paymentsBody: The second party shall pay the contract value in the following instalments, each due when its stage is reached:
contract.s_paymentsLate: If any due payment is more than 7 days late after notice, the first party may suspend work, and the duration is extended by the suspension period.
contract.s_durationBody: The duration is {days} days starting {start}, with expected completion on {end}. It is extended for additional works, delays by the second party in its obligations or payments, or circumstances beyond the first party's control.
contract.s_durationLabour: The first party is not responsible for delays caused by late supply of materials by the second party.
contract.o1_execute: Carry out the works to the agreed specifications with qualified labour under technical supervision.
contract.o1_supply: Supply the materials of the types and brands in the specifications.
contract.o1_safety: Follow safety procedures and protect the property on site.
contract.o1_clean: Clean its debris from the site at handover.
contract.o1_warranty: Repair any workmanship defects that appear during the warranty at no cost.
contract.o2_site: Hand over the site ready and clear on the start date, and give the first party access.
contract.o2_utilities: Provide water and electricity on site throughout the works.
contract.o2_approve: Approve colours and samples on time so the work is not delayed.
contract.o2_materials: Supply the required materials in the quantities and specifications needed, on time.
contract.s_handoverBody: The first party notifies the second party when each stage is complete; the second party has 3 days from notice to inspect and give written remarks, otherwise the stage is deemed accepted. Final acceptance is by a handover certificate.
contract.s_additionalBody: Any work outside this scope, or change to it, is carried out only under a written addendum approved by the second party before starting, stating its value, duration and separate payment.
contract.s_warrantyBody: The first party warrants the works against workmanship defects for {n} months from final acceptance. The warranty excludes damage from misuse, leaks, structural cracks or works by others.
contract.s_terminationBody: If either party breaches its obligations and does not remedy the breach within 15 days of written notice, the other party may terminate. In all cases the first party is entitled to the value of works executed and materials supplied up to termination.
contract.s_forceBody: Neither party is liable for delays caused by force majeure or circumstances beyond its control; the duration is extended accordingly.
contract.s_noticesBody: Messages by WhatsApp, email and the project's online page, to the parties' details above, are valid notices.
contract.s_lawBody: This contract is governed by the Civil Transactions Law of the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. Disputes are settled amicably, failing which the competent court in {city} has jurisdiction.
contract.s_lawBodyNoCity: This contract is governed by the Civil Transactions Law of the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. Disputes are settled amicably, failing which the competent courts of the Kingdom have jurisdiction.
contract.s_signingBody: This contract is made electronically; the second party's acceptance through its private link is a binding signature under the Electronic Transactions Law, and each party keeps a copy.
